title: Effects of Clobazam on Sleep and Daytime Function in Patients With Epilepsy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to monitor the effect of Clobazam on sleep and daytime alertness in people with Epilepsy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adults aged 18 years or older
* diagnosis of epilepsy who are being considered for treatment with Clobazam

Exclusion Criteria:

* known untreated moderate or severe sleep apnea
* major circadian rhythm disorders
study_population: Adults with Epilepsy who have recently been started on Clobazam (Onfi)
